question: How should this part be made?
title: Manufacturing Processes: A Practical Reference
lede: Manufacturing is a chain of processes — producing raw stock, shaping parts, joining assemblies, modifying properties and surfaces, and verifying the result. This guide catalogs {{N_ENTRIES}} processes across seven layers, from continuous casting to statistical process control.
